\subsection{Decisions}\label{sec:docs-decisions}

\begin{sloppypar}
Decisions 1 to 5 were stated as questions in the first version of the status (commit \texttt{51021d9}). Today the status says only ``Decision 1 was taken with \#13, and decision 3 with revision 2'' (\texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}status.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}214}): what decision 1 decided is no longer written anywhere in the current documents, and decisions 6 to 10 exist only as outcomes (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}217-\allowbreak{}224}). Two further choices ``were made'' without a number (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}224-\allowbreak{}227}: the seams carry claims only; the schedules travel with the definitions). The blueprint cites ``decision 8'' and ``decision 6'' (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}557,\allowbreak{} 560}) and defines neither. The leanISA roadmap numbers its own decisions from 1, so ``decision 13'' is ``public lines, not cells'' here and ``the program is a parameter'' in the title of issue 22, and \texttt{leanth-\allowbreak{}reuse.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}485}, a proof-system document, cites ``Decision 14'' of leanISA without saying so.
\end{sloppypar}

\subsection{The upstream ledger's row on Merkle trees}\label{sec:docs-merkle}

\begin{sloppypar}
The blueprint's ledger says of ArkLib at the pin: ``A7 WHIR, Merkle, BLAKE2s \textbar{} absent (only coding-theory lemmas) \textbar{} Layer 11 \textbar{} Written here'' (\texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}blueprint.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}265}), and Layer 11 plans \texttt{merkleRoot} and \texttt{merkleVerify} locally (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}1179-\allowbreak{}1182}). The blueprint's list of what is consumed from VCVio has one row, \texttt{SampleableType} (\texttt{:\allowbreak{}251}), and the survey record lists the same (\texttt{protocol-\allowbreak{}status.\allowbreak{}md:\allowbreak{}607-\allowbreak{}609}).
\end{sloppypar}

\begin{sloppypar}
Fact, at the pin \texttt{f9dc47d9} of VCVio (the revision leanerVM builds against, through ArkLib): the directory \texttt{.\allowbreak{}lake/\allowbreak{}packages/\allowbreak{}VCVio/\allowbreak{}VCVio/\allowbreak{}Crypto\allowbreak{}Foundations/\allowbreak{}Merkle\allowbreak{}Tree/\allowbreak{}} holds nineteen modules (\texttt{Inductive/\allowbreak{}\{\allowbreak{}Defs,\allowbreak{}Completeness,\allowbreak{}Binding,\allowbreak{}Extractability,\allowbreak{}Extractor,\allowbreak{}Query\allowbreak{}Bound,\allowbreak{}Uniqueness\}.\allowbreak{}lean}, four under \texttt{Inductive/\allowbreak{}Batch/\allowbreak{}}, six under \texttt{Addressed/\allowbreak{}}, two under \texttt{Vector/\allowbreak{}}), with no \texttt{sorry} in any of them (\texttt{grep -\allowbreak{}rn sorry}: 0 lines), for example \texttt{theorem functional\_\allowbreak{}completeness} at \texttt{Inductive/\allowbreak{}Completeness.\allowbreak{}lean:\allowbreak{}41}. And ArkLib's Merkle tracker, which four documents cite as the upstream of this work, was closed on 2026-09-27 in favour of VCVio issue 571.
\end{sloppypar}

\begin{sloppypar}
Inference, not verified: that this library fits leanVM's Merkle trees (BLAKE2s, leanVM's leaf encoding and pruned paths). Verifying it means reading \texttt{Inductive/\allowbreak{}Defs.\allowbreak{}lean} against \texttt{crates/\allowbreak{}fiat\_\allowbreak{}shamir/\allowbreak{}src/\allowbreak{}merkle.\allowbreak{}rs:\allowbreak{}14-\allowbreak{}67}; it belongs to the review of Layer 11. What is established here is that the ledger and the survey record do not mention a library that is in the build, and that the upstream destination they name no longer exists.
\end{sloppypar}
